snippet.title: PARCEL INSPECTOR SIMULATOR — Announcement Trailer | Free Demo Out Now
snippet.description:
Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5334110/Parcel_Inspector_Simulator/

1962. The night shift at a transit post office. Every parcel that crosses your desk gets weighed, X-rayed, checked against the records and stamped: approve, return, hold, dispose or confiscate.

PARCEL INSPECTOR SIMULATOR is a first-person inspection sim about paperwork, small lies and one long favour somebody upstairs keeps asking for.

• Weigh, scan, check: scale, fluoroscope, UV lamp, probe and the terminal
• Regulations that change every night
• A 20-night story campaign with 7 endings, then endless nights
• Pay the bills, upgrade the desk, follow the thread on the case board
• 13 languages

The demo covers the first five nights.

#indiegame #simulator #steam
